## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

**Intra-wave (W2-1) — the §VII.CK UNCONDITIONAL flip pathway:**

- **W2-1 PASS** (single reconciled mechanism established: `t(R_X)=0` machine-exact + leg-membership + W3-1 residual=1.0) → the D4 mechanism is no longer contested. **Next**: (i) `mack-cosmic-bridge` (sole writer) applies the mechanism-label corrigendum to the §VII.CK Four-door D4 row + D4-disposition annotation (replace the `t(O)=±1` mechanism label with the commutant/Skolem–Noether leg-membership mechanism + the coset-shift-grading clarification; RETAIN the original text as superseded per audit-trail preservation). (ii) Dispatch the **Stage-2 blind cross-axis RE-VERIFY** on the corrected mechanism with a **DISJOINT COMPLIANT pair** — axis-distinct, NOT on the §VII.CK exclusion set `{connes, paasch, van-den-dungen, baptista, kaluza-klein}`, NOT the adjudication author (connes), reading only the registered §VII.CK entry. **Candidate pair**: Axis-A `lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist` (NCG/spectral-functional; reviewed D1/D2/D3 not D4; not a Stage-0 author) × Axis-B `volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist` (substrate/superfluid; S115 D4 Axis-B affirmed the commutant identity) — the orchestrator finalizes the pair per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage-2 Axis-B Selection Protocol"` (axis-distinctness + original-author-exclusion + audit-coverage adequacy). (iii) On clean PASS-AND → `mack` flips §VII.CK **STAGE-3-PERMANENT → STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL**. *This re-verify + flip is the natural W2b sub-wave or an early-Wave-3 gate; it cannot be folded into W2-1 because the adjudication author (connes) is excluded from re-verifying their own adjudication.*
- **W2-1 INFO** → mechanism reconciled but genus-completeness not yet sufficient from the registered entry alone; §VII.CK holds STAGE-3-PERMANENT (D4-open); the UNCONDITIONAL flip is carried forward (re-verify still owed).
- **W2-1 FAIL** (not expected) → the registry `t(O)=±1` reading (or a third) survives; §VII.CK holds STAGE-3-PERMANENT (D4-open); the contest is re-opened as a fresh workshop.

**Intra-wave (W2-2 × W2-3) — the lepton shape-leg status (joint reading):**

| W2-2 workshop verdict | W2-3 compute verdict | Lepton shape-leg status |
|:----------------------|:---------------------|:------------------------|
| Track A (ε_LX rescuable, derivation) | PASS (mix_grp ≥ 3) | **RESCUED** — first DERIVED lepton-mixing texture; the ℂ⊕ℍ sector-asymmetry is a genuine substrate DOF. Register the lepton ε_LX texture (mack); candidate §VII companion to the quark CKM-triality texture. |
| Track A | INFO (mix_grp = 2) | **RESCUED-WITH-HELD-NUMBER** — the sector-asymmetry helps but a mass-vs-mixing tension persists (lepton analog of quark V_us); NON-PROMOTION-BY-HELD-NUMBER (undischarged-magnitude-bound). |
| Track B (walled) | FAIL (mix_grp ≤ 1) | **WALLED** — PMNS shares the quark multiplicity-scalar wall; the 2.9× was a coincidence. Consistent verdict; closes the lepton shape leg as §VII.CK-walled. |
| Track A | FAIL, or Track B | INFO/PASS | **TENSION** — the workshop reading and the compute number disagree → forward-route as a `CF-S117` adjudication (genuinely-unreconciled per `Investigating-Workshops.md` Q1). |

**Forward to Wave 3 (Q3 Goldstone mass)**: no dependency — Wave 2 and Wave 3 are independent (different question). The §VII.CK UNCONDITIONAL re-verify (if W2-1 PASS) is the leading Wave-2-internal carry-forward.
